<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>Grindhouse Skate Co. | Shop & Lessons</title>
<meta name="description" content="Decks, trucks, wheels, and pro-led skateboard lessons for every level.">
<style>
  :root {
    --ink: #111214;
    --ink-2: #1c1e22;
    --paper: #f4f1ea;
    --white: #ffffff;
    --muted: #8a8d94;
    --line: rgba(255,255,255,0.1);
    --acid: #d7ff3a;
    --hot: #ff4d2e;
    --sky: #4cc9f0;
    --radius: 14px;
    --max: 1180px;
    --font-display: "Arial Black", "Helvetica Neue", Impact, sans-serif;
    --font-body: system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif;
  }

  * { box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; padding: 0; }
  html { scroll-behavior: smooth; }
  body {
    font-family: var(--font-body);
    background: var(--ink);
    color: var(--paper);
    line-height: 1.6;
    -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased;
  }
  a { color: inherit; text-decoration: none; }
  img, svg { display: block; max-width: 100%; }

  .wrap { max-width: var(--max); margin: 0 auto; padding: 0 24px; }
  .eyebrow {
    font-size: 0.78rem;
    letter-spacing: 0.18em;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    color: var(--acid);
    font-weight: 700;
    margin-bottom: 12px;
    display: inline-block;
  }
  h1, h2, h3 { font-family: var(--font-display); line-height: 1.05; letter-spacing: -0.01em; }
  h1 { font-size: clamp(2.6rem, 6vw, 5rem); text-transform: uppercase; }
  h2 { font-size: clamp(2rem, 4vw, 3rem); text-transform: uppercase; }
  h3 { font-size: 1.25rem; text-transform: uppercase; }
  section { padding: 110px 0; position: relative; }
  .section-head { margin-bottom: 52px; max-width: 640px; }
  .section-head p { color: var(--muted); margin-top: 14px; font-size: 1.05rem; }

  .btn {
    display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px;
    padding: 15px 26px; border-radius: 999px;
    font-weight: 700; font-size: 0.95rem; border: 2px solid transparent;
    cursor: pointer; transition: transform .15s ease, background .2s, color .2s, border-color .2s;
    font-family: var(--font-body);
  }
  .btn:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); }
  .btn-primary { background: var(--acid); color: var(--ink); }
  .btn-primary:hover { background: #e6ff6b; }
  .btn-ghost { border-color: var(--line); color: var(--paper); background: transparent; }
  .btn-ghost:hover { border-color: var(--paper); }
  .btn-sm { padding: 10px 18px; font-size: 0.85rem; }

  /* ---------- NAV ---------- */
  header {
    position: sticky; top: 0; z-index: 50;
    background: rgba(17,18,20,0.82);
    backdrop-filter: blur(12px);
    border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line);
  }
  .nav { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; height: 72px; }
  .logo { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; font-family: var(--font-display); font-size: 1.1rem; text-transform: uppercase; }
  .logo-mark {
    width: 34px; height: 34px; border-radius: 9px;
    background: var(--acid); color: var(--ink);
    display: grid; place-items: center; font-size: 1rem;
  }
  .nav-links { display: flex; gap: 32px; list-style: none; }
  .nav-links a { font-size: 0.92rem; color: #cfd1d6; transition: color .2s; }
  .nav-links a:hover { color: var(--acid); }
  .nav-cta { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 16px; }
  .cart-count {
    font-size: 0.85rem; color: var(--muted);
  }
  .menu-toggle {
    display: none; background: none; border: 0; color: var(--paper);
    font-size: 1.6rem; cursor: pointer;
  }

  /* ---------- HERO ---------- */
  .hero {
    padding: 90px 0 80px;
    overflow: hidden;
    background:
      radial-gradient(900px 500px at 85% 10%, rgba(215,255,58,0.12), transparent 60%),
      radial-gradient(700px 500px at 0% 100%, rgba(255,77,46,0.13), transparent 60%),
      var(--ink);
  }
  .hero-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1.1fr 0.9fr; gap: 60px; align-items: center; }
  .hero h1 span { color: var(--acid); }
  .hero-lede { font-size: 1.15rem; color: #b9bcc3; margin: 24px 0 36px; max-width: 520px; }
  .hero-actions { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 14px; }
  .hero-stats {
    display: flex; gap: 40px; margin-top: 56px; padding-top: 28px;
    border-top: 1px solid var(--line); flex-wrap: wrap;
  }
  .stat strong { display: block; font-family: var(--font-display); font-size: 2rem; color: var(--paper); }
  .stat span { font-size: 0.85rem; color: var(--muted); }

  .hero-art {
    position: relative; height: 520px;
  }
  .hero-art .ring {
    position: absolute; border-radius: 50%;
    border: 1px dashed rgba(215,255,58,0.35);
    inset: 40px;
    animation: spin 40s linear infinite;
  }
  .hero-art .ring::after {
    content: ""; position: absolute; width: 12px; height: 12px; border-radius: 50%;
    background: var(--acid); top: -6px; left: 50%; margin-left: -6px;
  }
  @keyframes spin { to { transform: rotate(360deg); } }
  .deck-hero {
    position: absolute; left: 50%; top: 50%;
    width: 300px; height: 92px; transform: translate(-50%,-50%) rotate(-18deg);
    filter: drop-shadow(0 30px 40px rgba(0,0,0,0.5));
    animation: float 6s ease-in-out infinite;
  }
  @keyframes float {
    0%,100% { transform: translate(-50%,-50%) rotate(-18deg) translateY(0); }
    50% { transform: translate(-50%,-50%) rotate(-14deg) translateY(-14px); }
  }
  .deck-shape {
    width: 100%; height: 100%;
    border-radius: 999px / 50%;
    background: linear-gradient(120deg, var(--hot), #ff8a3d 50%, var(--acid));
    position: relative;
    box-shadow: inset 0 -6px 0 rgba(0,0,0,0.18), inset 0 4px 0 rgba(255,255,255,0.25);
  }
  .deck-shape::before {
    content: ""; position: absolute; left: 8%; right: 8%; top: 50%;
    height: 2px; background: rgba(17,18,20,0.55); transform: translateY(-50%);
  }
  .deck-shape::after {
    content: "GRINDHOUSE"; position: absolute; left: 50%; top: 50%;
    transform: translate(-50%,-50%); font-family: var(--font-display);
    font-size: 0.8rem; letter-spacing: 0.3em; color: var(--ink);
    white-space: nowrap; background: var(--paper); padding: 4px 10px; border-radius: 4px;
  }
  .badge-float {
    position: absolute; background: var(--paper); color: var(--ink);
    padding: 14px 18px; border-radius: 12px; font-weight: 700; font-size: 0.85rem;
    box-shadow: 0 20px 40px rgba(0,0,0,0.35);
  }
  .badge-float small { display: block; font-weight: 500; color: #555; font-size: 0.75rem; }
  .badge-a { top: 40px; left: 0; transform: rotate(-4deg); }
  .badge-b { bottom: 50px; right: 0; transform: rotate(3deg); background: var(--acid); }

  /* ---------- TICKER ---------- */
  .ticker {
    background: var(--acid); color: var(--ink); overflow: hidden; white-space: nowrap;
    padding: 16px 0; font-family: var(--font-display); text-transform: uppercase; font-size: 1.05rem;
  }
  .ticker-track { display: inline-block; animation: slide 28s linear infinite; }
  .ticker-track span { margin: 0 28px; }
  @keyframes slide { from { transform: translateX(0); } to { transform: translateX(-50%); } }

  /* ---------- SHOP ---------- */
  .cats { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(6, 1fr); gap: 14px; margin-bottom: 64px; }
  .cat {
    background: var(--ink-2); border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: var(--radius);
    padding: 24px 18px; text-align: center; transition: transform .2s, border-color .2s;
    cursor: pointer;
  }
  .cat:hover { transform: translateY(-4px); border-color: var(--acid); }
  .cat-icon {
    width: 46px; height: 46px; margin: 0 auto 14px; border-radius: 12px;
    background: rgba(215,255,58,0.1); color: var(--acid);
    display: grid; place-items: center; font-size: 1.3rem;
  }
  .cat h3 { font-size: 0.85rem; letter-spacing: 0.02em; }
  .cat p { color: var(--muted); font-size: 0.78rem; margin-top: 4px; }

  .products { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr); gap: 22px; }
  .product {
    background: var(--ink-2); border-radius: var(--radius); overflow: hidden;
    border: 1px solid var(--line); display: flex; flex-direction: column;
    transition: transform .25s, border-color .25s;
  }
  .product:hover { transform: translateY(-6px); border-color: rgba(215,255,58,0.4); }
  .product-art {
    height: 210px; position: relative; display: grid; place-items: center;
    background: radial-gradient(circle at 50% 40%, #2a2d33, #16181b);
  }
  .product-art .tag {
    position: absolute; top: 14px; left: 14px; font-size: 0.7rem; font-weight: 700;
    letter-spacing: 0.08em; text-transform: uppercase;
    background: var(--hot); color: var(--white); padding: 4px 9px; border-radius: 6px;
  }
  .product-art .tag.new { background: var(--acid); color: var(--ink); }
  .mini-deck {
    width: 150px; height: 40px; border-radius: 999px / 50%;
    transform: rotate(-12deg);
    box-shadow: inset 0 -3px 0 rgba(0,0,0,0.2), 0 18px 30px rgba(0,0,0,0.4);
  }
  .wheel {
    width: 74px; height: 74px; border-radius: 50%;
    background: var(--c, var(--sky));
    box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 14px rgba(0,0,0,0.25), inset 0 0 0 20px var(--c, var(--sky)), 0 18px 30px rgba(0,0,0,0.4);
  }
  .truck {
    width: 150px; height: 26px; border-radius: 6px;
    background: linear-gradient(#c9ccd3, #7d8189);
    position: relative; box-shadow: 0 16px 26px rgba(0,0,0,0.4);
  }
  .truck::before, .truck::after {
    content: ""; position: absolute; width: 18px; height: 18px; border-radius: 50%;
    background: #2d3036; bottom: -14px;
  }
  .truck::before { left: 14px; } .truck::after { right: 14px; }
  .product-body { padding: 20px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; flex: 1; }
  .product-body .brand { font-size: 0.75rem; color: var(--muted); text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.1em; }
  .product-body h3 { font-size: 1rem; margin: 6px 0 14px; text-transform: none; font-family: var(--font-body); font-weight: 700; }
  .product-foot { margin-top: auto; display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; }
  .price { font-family: var(--font-display); font-size: 1.2rem; }
  .add-btn {
    width: 40px; height: 40px; border-radius: 50%; border: 0;
    background: var(--paper); color: var(--ink); font-size: 1.3rem; font-weight: 700;
    cursor: pointer; transition: background .2s, transform .15s;
  }
  .add-btn:hover { background: var(--acid); transform: rotate(90deg); }

  .shop-cta { text-align: center; margin-top: 48px; }

  /* ---------- LESSONS ---------- */
  .lessons { background: var(--paper); color: var(--ink); }
  .lessons .eyebrow { color: var(--hot); }
  .lessons .section-head p { color: #5b5e66; }
  .lesson-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr); gap: 24px; }
  .plan {
    background: var(--white); border-radius: 20px; padding: 36px 30px;
    border: 2px solid transparent; position: relative; display: flex; flex-direction: column;
    box-shadow: 0 10px 30px rgba(0,0,0,0.06);
  }
  .plan.featured { background: var(--ink); color: var(--paper); border-color: var(--ink); transform: translateY(-14px); }
  .plan .pill {
    position: absolute; top: -13px; left: 30px; background: var(--hot); color: var(--white);
    font-size: 0.72rem; font-weight: 700; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.1em;
    padding: 6px 12px; border-radius: 999px;
  }
  .plan .level { font-size: 0.8rem; font-weight: 700; color: var(--hot); text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.12em; }
  .plan.featured .level { color: var(--acid); }
  .plan h3 { font-size: 1.6rem; margin: 10px 0 8px; }
  .plan .desc { color: #5b5e66; font-size: 0.95rem; }
  .plan.featured .desc { color: #b9bcc3; }
  .plan .amount { font-family: var(--font-display); font-size: 3rem; margin: 22px 0 4px; }
  .plan .amount small { font-size: 0.95rem; font-family: var(--font-body); font-weight: 500; color: #7a7d85; }
  .plan.featured .amount small { color: var(--muted); }
  .plan ul { list-style: none; margin: 22px 0 30px; display: grid; gap: 12px; flex: 1; }
  .plan li { display: flex; gap: 10px; font-size: 0.95rem; }
  .plan li::before { content: "✓"; color: var(--hot); font-weight: 900; }
  .plan.featured li::before { color: var(--acid); }
  .plan .btn { justify-content: center; }
  .plan .btn-outline { border-color: var(--ink); color: var(--ink); background: transparent; }
  .plan .btn-outline:hover { background: var(--ink); color: var(--paper); }

  .schedule {
    margin-top: 80px; display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1.4fr; gap: 50px; align-items: start;
  }
  .schedule h3 { font-size: 1.6rem; margin-bottom: 14px; }
  .schedule p { color: #5b5e66; margin-bottom: 18px; }
  .checklist { list-style: none; display: grid; gap: 10px; }
  .checklist li { display: flex; gap: 10px; align-items: center; font-weight: 600; }
  .checklist li::before {
    content: ""; width: 10px; height: 10px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--acid);
    box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px var(--ink);
  }
  .timetable {
    background: var(--white); border-radius: 18px; overflow: hidden;
    box-shadow: 0 10px 30px rgba(0,0,0,0.06);
  }
  .timetable table { width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; font-size: 0.95rem; }
  .timetable th, .timetable td { padding: 16px 20px; text-align: left; border-bottom: 1px solid #eceae3; }
  .timetable th { background: var(--ink); color: var(--paper); font-weight: 600; font-size: 0.8rem; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.08em; }
  .timetable tr:last-child td { border-bottom: 0; }
  .timetable .lvl {
    display: inline-block; font-size: 0.72rem; font-weight: 700; text-transform: uppercase;
    padding: 4px 8px; border-radius: 6px; background: #eef5c9; color: #3d4a00;
  }
  .timetable .lvl.adv { background: #ffe0d9; color: #8a2411; }
  .timetable .lvl.kid { background: #d6f0fb; color: #0b4a63; }
  .timetable .full { color: #9a9da4; font-style: italic; }

  /* ---------- HOW IT WORKS ---------- */
  .steps { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr); gap: 24px; counter-reset: step; }
  .step {
    padding: 36px 30px; border-radius: var(--radius); background: var(--ink-2); border: 1px solid var(--line);
    position: relative;
  }
  .step-num {
    font-family: var(--font-display); font-size: 4rem; line-height: 1; color: transparent;
    -webkit-text-stroke: 1.5px var(--acid); margin-bottom: 18px;
  }
  .step h3 { margin-bottom: 10px; }
  .step p { color: var(--muted); font-size: 0.98rem; }

  /* ---------- INSTRUCTORS ---------- */
  .crew { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr); gap: 24px; }
  .coach {
    background: var(--ink-2); border-radius: var(--radius); padding: 30px;
    border: 1px solid var(--line); display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 16px;
  }
  .avatar {
    width: 84px; height: 84px; border-radius: 22px;
    display: grid; place-items: center; font-family: var(--font-display); font-size: 1.8rem;
    color: var(--ink);
  }
  .coach h3 { text-transform: none; font-family: var(--font-body); font-size: 1.2rem; font-weight: 800; }
  .coach .role { color: var(--acid); font-size: 0.85rem; font-weight: 600; margin-top: -10px; }
  .coach p { color: var(--muted); font-size: 0.95rem; }
  .coach .meta { display: flex; gap: 8px; flex-wrap: wrap; }
  .coach .meta span {
    font-size: 0.75rem; border: 1px solid var(--line); padding: 4px 10px; border-radius: 999px; color: #cfd1d6;
  }

  /* ---------- TESTIMONIALS ---------- */
  .quotes { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr); gap: 24px; }
  .quote {
    padding: 32px; border-radius: var(--radius); background: var(--paper); color: var(--ink);
  }
  .quote:nth-child(2) { background: var(--acid); }
  .quote:nth-child(3) { background: var(--sky); }
  .quote blockquote { font-size: 1.05rem; font-weight: 500; margin-bottom: 22px; }
  .quote cite { font-style: normal; font-size: 0.88rem; font-weight: 700; }
  .quote cite span { display: block; font-weight: 500; opacity: 0.7; }
  .stars { color: var(--ink); letter-spacing: 3px; margin-bottom: 16px; font-size: 0.9rem; }

  /* ---------- BOOKING ---------- */
  .booking { background: linear-gradient(160deg, #1a1c20, #0c0d0f); border-top: 1px solid var(--line); }
  .booking-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 0.9fr 1.1fr; gap: 70px; align-items: start; }
  .booking-copy p { color: var(--muted); margin: 18px 0 30px; font-size: 1.05rem; }
  .perks { list-style: none; display: grid; gap: 14px; }
  .perks li { display: flex; gap: 14px; align-items: flex-start; }
  .perks .ico {
    flex: 0 0 38px; height: 38px; border-radius: 10px; background: rgba(215,255,58,0.12);
    color: var(--acid); display: grid; place-items: center; font-size: 1rem;
  }
  .perks strong { display: block; }
  .perks span { color: var(--muted); font-size: 0.93rem; }

  form.book {
    background: var(--ink-2); border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 20px; padding: 40px;
    display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 18px;
  }
  form.book .full-row { grid-column: 1 / -1; }
  label { display: block; font-size: 0.82rem; font-weight: 600; margin-bottom: 7px; color: #cfd1d6; }
  input, select, textarea {
    width: 100%; padding: 13px 14px; border-radius: 10px; border: 1px solid #33363d;
    background: #121316; color: var(--paper); font: inherit; font-size: 0.95rem;
    transition: border-color .2s, box-shadow .2s;
  }
  input:focus, select:focus, textarea:focus {
    outline: none; border-color: var(--acid); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(215,255,58,0.18);
  }
  select option { background: #121316; }
  form.book .btn { width: 100%; justify-content: center; margin-top: 6px; }
  .form-msg { grid-column: 1 / -1; font-size: 0.95rem; color: var(--acid); min-height: 1.4em; text-align: center; }

  /* ---------- VISIT ---------- */
  .visit-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1.2fr; gap: 24px; }
  .hours, .map {
    border-radius: var(--radius); border: 1px solid var(--line); background: var(--ink-2);
  }
  .hours { padding: 36px; }
  .hours h3 { margin-bottom: 18px; }
  .hours-row { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; padding: 12px 0; border-bottom: 1px dashed var(--line); font-size: 0.97rem; }
  .hours-row:last-child { border-bottom: 0; }
  .hours-row b { color: var(--acid); font-weight: 600; }
  .hours address { font-style: normal; color: #cfd1d6; margin-top: 24px; font-size: 0.97rem; }
  .map {
    min-height: 380px; position: relative; overflow: hidden;
    background:
      linear-gradient(90deg, transparent 49%, rgba(255,255,255,0.06) 49%, rgba(255,255,255,0.06) 51%, transparent 51%),
      linear-gradient(0deg, transparent 49%, rgba(255,255,255,0.06) 49%, rgba(255,255,255,0.06) 51%, transparent 51%),
      linear-gradient(135deg, #1d2025, #15171a);
    background-size: 90px 90px, 90px 90px, auto;
  }
  .map .pin {
    position: absolute; left: 50%; top: 45%; transform: translate(-50%,-50%);
    width: 56px; height: 56px; border-radius: 50% 50% 50% 0; transform-origin: center;
    rotate: -45deg; background: var(--hot); box-shadow: 0 0 0 10px rgba(255,77,46,0.2);
  }
  .map .pin::after { content: ""; position: absolute; width: 18px; height: 18px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--ink); top: 19px; left: 19px; }
  .map .label {
    position: absolute; left: 50%; top: calc(45% + 44px); transform: translateX(-50%);
    background: var(--paper); color: var(--ink); font-weight: 700; padding: 8px 14px; border-radius: 8px; white-space: nowrap; font-size: 0.88rem;
  }
  .map .street {
    position: absolute; background: #2b2e35; color: #5c616b; font-size: 0.7rem; letter-spacing: 0.15em; text-transform: uppercase; padding: 4px 8px;
  }

  /* ---------- FOOTER ---------- */
  footer { border-top: 1px solid var(--line); padding: 70px 0 36px; background: #0a0b0c; }
  .foot-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1.6fr 1fr 1fr 1fr; gap: 40px; }
  .foot-grid p { color: var(--muted); font-size: 0.93rem; margin-top: 16px; max-width: 300px; }
  footer h4 { font-size: 0.82rem; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.12em; color: var(--paper); margin-bottom: 18px; }
  footer ul { list-style: none; display: grid; gap: 10px; }
  footer ul a { color: var(--muted); font-size: 0.93rem; transition: color .2s; }
  footer ul a:hover { color: var(--acid); }
  .news { display: flex; gap: 8px; margin-top: 4px; }
  .news input { padding: 11px 12px; }
  .news .btn { padding: 11px 16px; font-size: 0.85rem; }
  .foot-bottom {
    margin-top: 60px; padding-top: 26px; border-top: 1px solid var(--line);
    display: flex; justify-content: space-between; color: #5f636b; font-size: 0.85rem; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 12px;
  }

  /* ---------- RESPONSIVE ---------- */
  @media (max-width: 1040px) {
    .cats { grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr); }
    .products { grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr); }
    .foot-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; }
  }
  @media (max-width: 900px) {
    section { padding: 80px 0; }
    .hero-grid, .schedule, .booking-grid, .visit-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; gap: 50px; }
    .hero-art { height: 380px; }
    .lesson-grid, .steps, .crew, .quotes { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }

<script>
  // Mobile menu toggle
  const toggle = document.getElementById('menuToggle');
  const links = document.getElementById('navLinks');
  toggle.addEventListener('click', () => {
    const open = links.classList.toggle('open');
    toggle.textContent = open ? '✕' : '☰';
    toggle.setAttribute('aria-label', open ? 'Close menu' : 'Open menu');
  });
  links.querySelectorAll('a').forEach(a => a.addEventListener('click', () => {
    links.classList.remove('open');
    toggle.textContent = '☰';
  }));

  // Booking form (demo: no backend)
  const form = document.getElementById('bookForm');
  const msg = document.getElementById('formMsg');
  form.addEventListener('submit', e => {
    e.preventDefault();
    const name = form.name.value.split(' ')[0] || 'there';
    msg.textContent = `Thanks, ${name}! Your request is in. We'll confirm by email within a few hours.`;
    form.reset();
  });

  // Newsletter (demo)
  document.getElementById('newsForm').addEventListener('submit', e => {
    e.preventDefault();
    e.target.querySelector('input').value = '';
    e.target.querySelector('input').placeholder = "You're in. See you on the board.";
